top_signals.title: Copper Rises as Traders Weigh New Deliveries, Fed Rate Path
top_signals.summary: Copper advanced as traders weighed easing supply squeeze and bets that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates for the first time in three years.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: AI skeptics convene in Washington to urge action, as Congress, Trump idle
top_signals.summary: Lawmakers and AI regulation advocates met Tuesday in Washington at a Future of Life Institute event to urge regulatory action to rein in the expanding technology.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
